title: VahanHelp
summary: A digital automotive service platform that makes challan payments, RC transfer and RTO services simple, fast and transparent.
role: Software Engineer — full-stack build: frontend, REST APIs, payments & AWS deployment
challenge: Vehicle documentation and RTO processes are slow and confusing for most vehicle owners — from checking and paying traffic challans to transferring an RC — with little clarity on what each service involves or costs.
solution: As a software engineer at VahanHelp, I built a fast, user-friendly platform that brings vehicle services, challan checking and payment, Parivahan Mitra services and RTO assistance together in one place — with secure REST APIs, role-based access, Razorpay payments and quick support via WhatsApp. This is employment work, not a Codelyne client project.

title: Pink Vila
summary: A modern, responsive website for a family restaurant in Jaunpur — menu, ambience, reviews and table reservations in one place.
challenge: Pink Vila needed an online home that captures its signature pink-themed ambience and lets customers explore the full menu, find the restaurant and book a table without having to call first.
solution: I designed and built a concept website for the restaurant: a complete digital menu, featured dishes, a food and ambience gallery, customer reviews, Google Maps directions, one-tap call and WhatsApp, and a table reservation request flow.
features: Complete digital menu with categories & prices

title: The Olive Table
summary: A modern, elegant restaurant website with a premium sage-green and cream aesthetic — menu, gallery, reviews and table reservations in one place.
challenge: The Olive Table needed an online presence that matches its calm, refined dining experience — one that lets guests explore the menu, see the food and interiors, and request a table easily from any device.
solution: I designed and developed a concept website with a premium sage-green and cream aesthetic. It features an interactive digital menu, a food and interior gallery, customer reviews, restaurant information and table reservation requests — built with a focus on responsive design, intuitive navigation and a seamless experience across desktop and mobile.

title: Veloura
summary: A premium fashion e-commerce website delivering an elegant, seamless online shopping experience for a modern luxury brand.
challenge: A concept brief: a luxury fashion brand needs a digital storefront that feels as refined as its collections — presenting products with sophistication while keeping shopping simple and seamless.
solution: I designed and built Veloura end to end as a full-stack demo store: curated menswear, womenswear and accessories collections, a filterable catalog, cart and wishlist, a complete checkout flow, customer accounts, and a separate admin dashboard for orders, products and live sales stats.
features: Filterable, sortable product catalog with galleries
Customer accounts with order history & saved addresses
Admin dashboard for orders, products & customers
JWT sessions in httpOnly cookies, bcrypt-hashed passwords
